review.reason: The hole layout and overall illustration style are clear, but the putting greens read as nested surfaces because of their prominent dark collars.

issues.detail: The green has a strong dark concentric ring that makes the putting surface look nested. Use one continuous natural sage/apple-green surface with only a narrow, subtle fringe.
The putting surface is surrounded by a conspicuous dark ring. Reduce the collar so the green reads as one continuous natural surface.
